name: Phase-D: Shuki no Shou
source: The last chapter in the four-volume Phase D sci-fi visual novel series. There are four phases of human existence. From conception to birth is called Phase A. From birth to death is called Phase B. From death to disappearance of the corpse is Phase C. And last, remnant after the death, separate from the corpse, is referred to as Phase D. (from https://www.mobygames.com/game/psp/phase-d-akehime-no-sh )
translation:
这是四卷《Phase D》科幻视觉小说系列的最终章。

人类存在分为四个阶段。从受孕到出生称为 A 阶段；从出生到死亡称为 B 阶段；从死亡到尸体消失称为 C 阶段；最后，死亡后脱离尸体而残存的部分，被称为 D 阶段。

[来自 [https://www.mobygames.com/game/psp/phase-d-akehime-no-sh]MobyGames]
